title: Verify: Typed useUiStore hook export unit tests
summary: Unit tests for the hook export and component usage
description: Test the named export and its use from a React component through a selector, using the real store.
acceptance_criteria: Given the module, when imported, then useUiStore is a function exposing getState and setState
Given a component using useUiStore(s => s.soundEnabled), when toggleSound is called inside act, then the rendered text updates

steps.action:
Import { useUiStore } from '../src/store/uiStore'. Test 'is a hook with getState and setState' asserting typeof checks. Test 'component re-renders': render a component

{useUiStore(s => s.soundEnabled) ? 'on' : 'off'}

, assert 'on', call act(() => useUiStore.getState().toggleSound()), assert 'off'. Reset state in beforeEach.
